content: Transforming Faces Worldwide (TFW) is an international humanitarian organization dedicated to providing free surgical interventions and comprehensive rehabilitation for individuals with cleft lip and palate in developing countries. Established in 1999, TFW was the first organization globally to adopt a multidisciplinary approach to cleft care, offering both surgical treatment and long-term rehabilitation for cleft patients in resource-limited settings. The organization was founded on the principle of empowering local medical teams to deliver cleft lip and palate care within their own communities. TFW focuses on training surgeons and other specialists in partner countries to ensure they are equipped to treat and rehabilitate individuals with cleft conditions effectively. Currently, TFW collaborates with medical teams in Ghana, Ethiopia, India, Nepal, Thailand, Peru, and Argentina. Over the years, TFW has facilitated more than 2,500 surgical procedures and supported over 32,000 rehabilitation treatments for children affected by cleft lip and palate. Transforming Faces Worldwide is a registered Canadian charity, recognized by the Canada Revenue Agency.
